answer_1.quote: Relation extraction (RE) is the task of extracting semantic relations among entities within a given text, which has abundant applications such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and text analysis.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate on widely-adopted datasets for DocRE, including DocRED and Re-DocRED ... and report Precision, Recall, F1 and Ign F1.

answer_3.quote: We utilize LLM's self-supervision to enable it to make a second judgment on the document and each relation ... asking whether there is a relation. We judge based on the probability distribution of the first token output by the LLM, focusing on the token predictions of "T" (true) and "F" (false).
